draft.strengthQuote: Father was Pro Bowl cornerback and is now a coach.
draft.weaknessQuote: Would like to see more physicality to slow playmakers across from him.
draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 7.02, the 5th-best grade among 259 2021 draftees and 1st of 37 at CB. He went 9th overall, close to where his grade ranked. Published comparison: Nnamdi Asomugha. Testing standouts: broad jump (80th percentile). College production: his final season (2020) ranked 2nd in passes defended among the 36 CBs in his class with stats.

current.summary: Year 6 pro, currently with the Denver Broncos. 80 career games and 79 starts over 5 completed seasons, plus 4 so far in 2026. Trending down from his peak: 11 AV in 2025 against a career-best 15 in 2024. Strengths in 2025: approximate value 11 (98th percentile), passer rating allowed 66.6 (92nd percentile), passes defended 12 (88th percentile). Versus the typical Year-5 cornerback who played: 76.9% season snap share against a median of 33.5%, above the norm.
